declarations.description:
The mapping step of a spreadsheet import: each column of the user's file, with its first values, gets a field
picker, pre-filled by matching the header to the fields' keys, labels and aliases. A summary lists the required
fields and whether a column is mapped to each. Set `view="preview"` to show the rows as they will be imported:
one column per mapped field and each invalid cell marked with its message.

The file comes in three ways: `csv` (text the mapper parses; the first line is the header), `columns` and `rows`
(arrays of cells, or records keyed by header, as a spreadsheet library returns them), or `columns` and a
`dataSource` for a file too large to hold in memory. `csv` wins over the other two, and a `dataSource` is used
instead of `rows`. The mapper never reads the file itself: `c2-upload` or the app does.

`fields` describes the target: each field's `key`, `label`, `required`, `type` (`number`, `integer`, `date`,
`email`, `url`, `boolean`), `aliases`, `options`, `pattern`, and a `validate` function for the app's own rules.
`mapping` holds one field key (or `null`) per column; set it to restore a mapping, and `manual` to skip matching.
A field maps from one column at a time: picking it for a second column takes it from the first.

The mapper has no buttons of its own beyond the preview's pager: the app puts its Back, Preview and Import buttons in
the `toolbar` or `footer` slot, switches `view`, and reads `mapping`, `missing`, `validate()` and `records()`.

Accessibility: the host is a `group` named by `label`; each picker is named after its column ("Import column
“E-mail” as"), mapping changes are announced politely, and an invalid cell reads its message after its value.

cssParts.description: Region wrapping the `footer` slot below the mapping or the preview; hidden while the slot is empty.
cssParts.name: footer

cssParts.description: The required fields and the mapping status.
cssParts.name: summary

cssParts.description: One source column: its header, samples and picker.
cssParts.name: column

cssParts.description: The field picker of a column (a `c2-select`).
cssParts.name: picker

cssParts.description: The preview: summary, table and pager.

cssParts.name: state

slots.description: Above the mapping or the preview: the app's own actions (Preview, Import, Back). Hidden when empty.
slots.name: toolbar

slots.description: Below the mapping or the preview. Hidden when empty.
slots.name: footer

slots.description: Replaces the message shown while there is no file to map.

members.name: fields
members.description: The fields a column can be imported as. Set as JSON in markup; a field's `validate` function needs the property.

members.name: columns
members.description:
The file's headers, one per column. Leave it empty to read them from `rows`: the first row when rows are arrays,
the keys of the first record when they are records. Required with a `dataSource`.

members.name: rows
members.description: The file's data rows: arrays of cells in column order, or records keyed by header. Ignored while `csv` or a `dataSource` is set.

members.name: csv
members.description: Delimited text (comma, semicolon, tab or pipe, detected); its first line is the header. Wins over `columns`, `rows` and `dataSource`.

members.name: mapping
members.description:
One field key per source column, or `null` for a column that is not imported. Filled by matching the headers
whenever the file or the fields change, unless it is set at the same time or `manual` is set.

members.name: manual
members.description: Leave every column unmapped when a file arrives, instead of matching headers to fields.

members.name: view
members.description: `map` (the default) shows the columns and their pickers, `preview` the rows as they will be imported.

members.name: sampleCount
members.description: How many values each column shows as samples.

members.name: pageSize
members.description: How many rows a preview page shows.

members.name: page
members.description: The preview page shown, from 0.

members.name: errorsOnly
members.description: The preview shows only the rows with an error. With a `dataSource`, only within the loaded page.

members.name: label
members.description: Names the mapper for assistive technology.

members.name: dataSource
members.description: Rows read on demand, instead of `rows`. The headers come from `columns`.

members.name: matcher
members.description: Scores a header against a field from 0 to 100 (50 and up is a match), replacing the built-in matching.

members.name: renderSamples
members.description: Draws a column's sample values.

members.name: renderCell
members.description: Draws a preview cell's content; the mapper keeps the cell, its error state and its message.

members.name: loaded
members.description: With a `dataSource`: loaded rows by index, and the file's row count.

members.name: mapped
members.description: Whether the mapping has been applied to a file's columns yet.

members.name: committed
members.description: The last mapping the element set itself, to tell it from one the app sets.

members.name: missing
members.description: Keys of the required fields no column is mapped to.

members.name: headers
members.description: The source headers in use: from `csv`, `columns`, or the first row.

members.name: rowCount
members.description: How many data rows the file has.

members.name: autoMatch
members.description: Matches every unmapped column to a free field, keeping the columns already mapped.

members.name: clearMapping
members.description: Leaves every column unmapped.

members.name: reload
members.description: Asks the `dataSource` again for the rows shown, after an error or a change in the file.

members.name: validate
members.description:
Checks the mapped cells: every row, or with a `dataSource` the rows loaded so far. Messages are in the element's
language.

members.name: records
members.description: The mapped rows, keyed by field: every row, or with a `dataSource` the rows loaded so far.

members.name: load
members.description: Loads the rows the current view needs from the `dataSource`, dropping any answer a newer request superseded.

members.name: remote
members.description: Rows come from the `dataSource`: one is set and `csv`, which wins over it, is not.

members.name: checkedRows
members.description: Indexes of the rows validation covers.

members.name: goTo
members.description: Shows a page; when the button pressed turns disabled at either end, focus moves to the other one.

events.name: mapping-change
events.description: After the user picks a field for a column, and after `autoMatch()` or `clearMapping()`; `detail` is `{ mapping, column, field, missing }`.
